facts.fact: The Zambia Statistics Agency's national analytical report presents results from the 2022 Census of Population and Housing, which collected education and literacy data (national literacy 62.6 percent among people aged 5 and older); the document gives no exact enumeration date, so the year 2022 is used.

note: Report chapter is not described as final or definitive results, so no results fact; earlier census rounds 2000 and 2010 are cited only as comparison years.
